beforeImage.name: TotalEnergies U.S. Solar Portfolio JV
beforeImage.description: This joint venture holds a portfolio of contracted utility-scale solar assets in the United States. Its end markets are power buyers under long-term contracts and wholesale electricity systems supported by operating solar generation assets. The operating model is asset-heavy and contracted, with equity returns driven by ownership of operating renewable projects rather than a development-only platform. TotalEnergies announced in September 2025 that it would divest 50% of a 1.4 GW North American solar portfolio to insurance vehicles and funds managed by KKR, describing the assets as de-risked operating renewable infrastructure. The transaction positioned KKR as a 50% co-owner alongside TotalEnergies within the portfolio-level joint venture structure.

milestones.event: TotalEnergies described the portfolio as operating renewable assets that had reached commercial operation and been de-risked.
The transaction established a 50/50 ownership structure between TotalEnergies and KKR across the portfolio.
TotalEnergies announced the sale of a 50% interest in a 1.4 GW North American solar portfolio to KKR-managed vehicles.

afterImage.name: TotalEnergies North American Solar Portfolio (KKR co-investment)
aliases: TotalEnergies 1.4 GW North American solar portfolio
afterImage.description: This descriptive portfolio grouping covers the two target holdcos in TotalEnergies' December 2025 sale of parallel 50% interests to KKR-managed insurance vehicles and accounts. The underlying North American portfolio comprises approximately 1.4 GW of operating utility-scale and distributed solar assets in the United States and Canada, including six utility-scale assets and 41 distributed-generation assets. TotalEnergies retained 50%, joint control and the operator role; KKR acquired the other 50%. The two holdcos, JVPTR acquisition vehicle and underlying project entities are embedded in this single record rather than counted as separate portfolio companies.
